description: Filing a report for a crime or lost valuable items.
required_documents: Proof of ownership (if item is stolen/lost)
application_mode: In-person at Police Station Front Desk
rejection_guidance: If the front desk refuses to register the FIR, you have the legal right to submit a written petition to the SP (Superintendent of Police) Complaint Cell or file a petition in the Sessions Court under Section 22-A/22-B CrPC.
steps: Write an application addressed to the SHO of the jurisdiction where incident occurred.
Visit the Police Station Front Desk.
Submit the application and get a Diary Number (E-Tag).
Follow up for FIR registration copy.
